duration: 17 weeks, about 5 hours a week in person plus 1 to 2 hours of homework
name: Creative Career Cohort
what_you_do: Learn photography and design, work on real projects for paying clients, build a portfolio and practice job interviews. Meets twice a week at the Youth in Focus office.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 15 to 19 who identify as Black, Indigenous or a person of color, are in grades 10 to 12, and can attend every Tuesday and Thursday 4:30 to 7 PM for 17 weeks. Priority goes to teens without arts classes at school.
deadline_text: 2027 application "opens soon". Exact dates are not set on the page. The page lists the 2027 steps as a November deadline (a Sunday, date not set), interviews in December and a January start.
how_to_apply: Apply on the program page. About 25 applicants are chosen to interview for 10 spots.
notes: Only 10 spots. Graduates can later be hired for Youth in Focus photo jobs. Exact dates are not set on the page.
